# 行舟 · 个人行动与生活系统 v0.8.0

这一版本把每日 Checklist 正式纳入生活节律：它负责沿时间顺序提醒“什么时候做什么”，而今日记录继续负责保存结果、时长和观察。两者职责分离，但在同一套界面中自然衔接。

## 主要更新

- 生活节律新增独立的“每日 Checklist”页面，并将它置于“今日记录”之前。内置工作日、周六和周日三套提醒，内容与纸质版一致，但去除了需要填写的空白字段。
- 同时提供适合屏幕操作的“行舟视图”和保留纸面观感的“纸质视图”。两种视图共享当天勾选，切换视图或模块不会丢失；勾选不进入历史，新日期自动清空。
- Checklist 的时间节点、标题、提醒内容和纸质区块样式均可编辑，也可新增、删除和调整节点顺序。
- 模板与显示偏好保存在独立的 `checklist.json`，使用修订号、三份轮换备份和写后复核保护；修复了初次写入时由 JSON 字段顺序造成的完整性误报。
- 纸质视图现在保持主清单＋右侧进度卡布局，不再切换后突然居中；两种视图的字体、时间标签和复选框均已适度放大。打印时仍只输出纸质清单。
- 21:00 复盘中的下班后工作、异常观察，以及工作闭环中的下一步安排改为先作“是／否”判断，仅在需要时显示输入框。
- 睡前安排新增“自由安排，不记录计划”，并允许计划熄灯选择当晚或次日，完整保存跨午夜的日期与时间。

## 升级说明

本版本兼容现有 `work-items.json` 与 `daily-records.json`，无需迁移。首次打开 Checklist 时会建立独立配置文件；现有晚间记录会根据已有内容自动推断新的判断状态。Checklist 勾选刻意不持久化，不会污染历史数据。

## 下载

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

完整记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v0.8.0/CHANGELOG.md)。

# Xingzhou · Personal Action & Life System v0.8.0

This release brings Daily Checklist into Life Rhythm as a first-class workflow. Checklist provides chronological reminders for what to do and when, while Today remains responsible for storing results, durations, and observations. The two roles stay distinct but flow naturally within one interface.

## Highlights

- Added a standalone Daily Checklist page before Today in Life Rhythm. It includes Workday, Saturday, and Sunday templates matching the paper edition while omitting fields that previously required handwriting.
- Added Xingzhou and Paper views. Both share the same-day check state across view and module switches; checks never enter history and clear automatically on a new date.
- Checklist time nodes, titles, reminders, and paper-section styles are editable. Nodes can also be added, removed, and reordered.
- Templates and display preference use an independent `checklist.json` protected by revisions, three rotating backups, and read-after-write verification. The false first-write integrity warning caused by JSON property order is fixed.
- Paper view now retains the main-checklist plus progress-sidebar layout instead of jumping to an isolated centered sheet. Typography, time labels, and checkboxes are larger in both views, while printing still outputs only the paper checklist.
- After-hours work, anomaly observations, and closure next steps now begin with explicit Yes / No decisions and reveal text fields only when needed.
- Bedtime planning now supports Free arrangement and explicit Same evening / Next day lights-off dates, preserving full local date-time across midnight.

## Upgrade notes

This release is compatible with existing `work-items.json` and `daily-records.json`; no migration is required. Checklist creates its own configuration file on first use, and existing evening records infer the new decision states from their current content. Checklist checks intentionally remain non-persistent and never pollute historical records.

## Download

Download the attached `package.zip`. Do not use GitHub's automatically generated source-code archives as the SiYuan plugin package.

See [CHANGELOG.en.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v0.8.0/CHANGELOG.en.md) for the complete record.
